<!-- pr-reviewer: 7ab1d7689123cfc754d9592ac27bc62f2a11181f -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge** (after its parents; see merge order).

## What looks good
- `cycleSeat` in `assets/posts/fanuc-lathe.cps` (~line 718) follows the hop law: Z out to R when below it, X to centre, Z down when above. The old diagonal `G00 X0 Z<R>` is gone, and the cycle block is written only after the tool stands on its seat.
- It refuses by name, with no cycle written: a first-motion cycle (no stream position), a bottom not below R (direction unknown), and a legacy no-R record that starts off axis. A stale open group is closed with `G80` before the seat moves.
- `seatKnown` is reset per section and set on every motion, so `currentPosition` is only trusted after a real move.
- The checker in `lathe_cycle_exit.rs` now reads the seat too, and a negative test shows it catches the old diagonal. The two `lathe_post_refusals` fixture edits only add the approach rapid and shift `first_move`; their assertions are unchanged. tormach-lathe is untouched and pinned.
- Decision file present, "Fixes #1026", Changelog line present, conventional subject, no process files, no CHANGELOG/snapshot edits, no new deps or build.rs/scripts/.github changes.

## Stacking and merge order
Commits above main: b21879ac, d1e1245a (#964), 7e01f463 (#975), 1f156d30 (#1025), 7ab1d768 (this PR). `git merge-tree` of this head against #1025, #964, #975 and #990: all clean (no conflicts). Against current main: clean. Merge order: #964, #975, #1025, then #1042 (retarget/merge-main as usual; #990 is independent and can go anywhere).

## Local results (head trial-merged with current upstream/main, clean merge)
| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| lathe_cycle_exit | 6 passed |
| lathe_post | 7 passed |
| lathe_post_refusals | 7 passed |
| lathe_post_g76 | 8 passed |
| lathe_cross_drill | 5 passed |
| lathe_post_tormach | 7 passed |
| posting | 17 passed |
| golden_cl | 25 passed |
| c_axis_fixture / c_axis_live / c_axis_unwind | 2 / 5 / 7 passed |
| drilling_axial, turning_face_approach, drill_prior, drill_prior_kinds, lathe_spindle_law, program_entry | 7, 3, 12, 4, 8, 9 passed |
| clippy `-p camcraft-app --tests -D warnings` | clean |

## Golden change, line by line
This PR changes no golden. The only golden delta in the stack, `golden/nc/fanuc-lathe/axial_drill.nc` `+G00 X0 Z30` (the post-G80 exit rapid at the stream's clearance level instead of leaving at R), comes from #1025's commit, not from this PR; the diff between #1025's head and this head touches only the .cps, the two test files and the decision file. `lathe_post` and `golden_cl` pass.

## Requested before merge
None.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)
1. A second cycle record arriving while a group is open now goes through `cycleSeat` (the old code skipped positioning when `inCycle`). If `currentPosition` there sits below R (e.g. at the previous bottom) it would write `G80` + `G00 Z<R>`. No test covers two consecutive cycles on one hole; worth a pin if the generator can emit that.
2. Not exercised (as the body says): G84/G85 off-seat, a real control/simulator, inverted-Z machines.
3. The `+Z is away from the work` assumption is checked only through bottom < R; fine for the shipped lathes.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
